title: A Chicago violet
done: You made a violet! It is the state flower of Illinois, and children voted for it in 1907.

steps.say: Put a yellow square flat on the table. It is the middle of the violet.
Put a purple square on the left. A petal!
Put a purple square on the right.
Put a purple square above the left one.
Put a purple square above the right one.
Put a purple square under the middle. That is five petals.
Put a small green triangle on the bottom left. A leaf.
Put a small green triangle on the bottom right. Another leaf.
